neet_phy_u13_t02_1.working: The magnetic force qv×B is always perpendicular to the velocity, so it does no work. Speed and kinetic energy stay constant, while the direction of velocity (and momentum) changes.

neet_phy_u13_t02_2.working: From qV = p²/2m, p = √(2mqV). Then r = p/(qB) = √(2mV/q)/B, so r ∝ √(m/q). For the proton m/q = 1; for the alpha particle m/q = 4/2 = 2. So r_p : r_α = 1 : √2.

neet_phy_u13_t02_3.working: The radius is r = v sin60°/ω = 3 cm. The pitch is p = v cos60° · 2π/ω = 2πr·cot60° = 2π·3/√3 = 2√3π cm.

neet_phy_u13_t02_4.working: The undeflected condition qE = qvB gives v = E/B, which is independent of q and m. So the selector picks a speed, not a charge-to-mass ratio. A is false and R is true.

neet_phy_u13_t02_5.working: The period T = 2πm/(qB) does not depend on speed, so Statement I is false. The proton and electron have opposite charges, so they circulate in opposite senses; Statement II is false.
